objective: Classify where the already-recorded final-checkpoint task-0 traces first stop satisfying predeclared approach/grasp/lift/transport/placement observables, without policy inference, retraining, changing formal evaluation, or advancing task count.

current_gate_snapshot.historical_native_task0_positive_control: 5/5 fixed-condition repeated success; binary outcome repeatability verified, not generalization
current_gate_snapshot.current_pipeline_lr10x_task0_10k: 5/5 fixed init3 and 12/20 paired; passed its registered single-task diagnostic gate, but is not the matched 40k/batch2 control
current_gate_snapshot.current_recipe_task0_40k_batch2: 3/5 fixed init3 and 11/20 paired; failed the registered 5/5 fixed-repeat criterion, so stable success under this matched-recipe control is not demonstrated
current_gate_snapshot.matched_joint4_task0_40k: 4/5 fixed init3 and 14/20 paired; failed its registered fixed-repeat progression criterion
current_gate_snapshot.task_count_scaling: LOCKED; do not advance to 8/16/32 on these results

options_compared.reason: Training changes the policy and adds cost but cannot locate the already-observed failures in the task sequence.
The existing outcome/action/state audit already shows cap-limited failures; another uninstrumented pass still lacks object/contact/stage observables and can duplicate evidence.
New inference can produce different outcomes and would confound stage diagnosis with execution variability. Consider only if action-trace replay is invalid and after a separately reviewed protocol.

It adds object pose, contact/grasp proxy, lift, target proximity, and placement observables to already-recorded policy actions without changing the policy, checkpoint, or success-rate evidence. Replay parity is a fail-closed prerequisite.
The matched current-recipe task-0 5/5 repeatability gate and the matched joint4 fixed-repeat progression gate both failed; this diagnostic cannot override either gate.

selected_protocol.source_population: existing private task-0 final-checkpoint evaluation records only
selected_protocol.trace_selection: 20 paired init indices 0..19 at step 40000 plus the four registered additional fixed-init3 repeats; exclude the 10k/20k/30k probes because this audit targets final-checkpoint failure stages
selected_protocol.source_data_handling: Resolve existing summary/action CSV pairs in place on the private evaluation host; do not download or publish raw traces.
selected_protocol.initialization_protocol: Reproduce eval_v3_task0 semantics exactly: reset, set the recorded benchmark initial state, execute the registered 10 zero-action wait steps, then replay each recorded applied_action in order.
per_step_capture: source robot state_0..state_14 and replay robot state before each recorded action
target bowl, target plate, and any BDDL-confirmed ramekin pose relative to the end effector and target
left/right finger-pad contact with the bowl and the simulator grasp proxy
bowl lift relative to its post-wait baseline
bowl/plate and bowl/ramekin contact, plate-support predicate, and official env.check_success()
replay reward and source action step index
selected_protocol.runtime_object_validation: Before any trace replay, resolve target object names from the active official task BDDL/environment observations. Require the bowl and plate; record a ramekin only if that object is present. Fail closed on missing/ambiguous object or geometry names; do not infer object identity from a guessed key.

predeclared_stage_proxies.approach: end-effector to bowl distance <= 0.05 m at any captured pre-action state
predeclared_stage_proxies.grasp: bilateral left/right finger-pad contact and the simulator grasp proxy; require agreement during preflight
predeclared_stage_proxies.lift: bowl z displacement >= 0.03 m relative to post-wait baseline
predeclared_stage_proxies.transport: bowl XY distance to plate center <= 0.08 m
predeclared_stage_proxies.placement_terminal: native plate-on-top predicate and official task success; require agreement during preflight and capture release/contact sequence without claiming grasp from gripper qpos alone

selected_protocol.stage_label_rule: Report every stage event and its first step. For an unsuccessful trace, label only the earliest proxy not observed before trace end as the first-unreached stage; retain later events and mark ambiguous/non-monotone sequences rather than forcing a single causal explanation.

replay_validity_gates.trace_inventory: exactly 24 distinct final-checkpoint source records; all inputs and hashes listed in a private manifest
replay_validity_gates.episode_steps_and_final_success: must exactly match the corresponding source summary
replay_validity_gates.contact_proxy_consistency: bilateral contacts must agree with simulator grasp proxy during the positive-control replay; official success must agree with the native plate-support predicate
replay_validity_gates.failure_action: on any gate failure, preserve partial outputs, label the trace/replay invalid for stage classification, and stop; no automatic retry or modification of old evidence

selected_protocol.smoke_then_full: After explicit authorization and fresh-root preflight, replay one deterministically selected recorded success and one failure as a smoke. Proceed to the remaining selected traces only if both pass all parity and instrumentation checks; otherwise preserve and stop.
selected_protocol.output_policy: New root must be verified absent before launch. Keep per-step replay traces and logs private on the evaluation host; publish only a lightweight aggregate, protocol/version/hash record, and interpretation limits.
selected_protocol.resource_policy: No GPU is needed for policy inference because no policy is run; simulator replay resource and duration must be measured in preflight. Do not start any remote process until explicit user authorization.

stop_and_interpretation_rules: A replay mismatch makes stage classifications for that trace invalid; it does not imply the source policy trace was wrong.
Object/contact/stage proxies are descriptive and do not prove why the policy failed or distinguish policy limitation from simulator variability.
This replay does not change formal LIBERO-36 results, any training/evaluation success gate, task-count authorization, or Fold02 status.
After completion, compare classified and unclassified failures against successful traces, then separately review a falsifiable training/data hypothesis before any new training plan.

implementation_status.review_note: Stage summaries preserve first observed step and mark non-monotone proxy sequences ambiguous; tests use synthetic CSVs only. Runtime replay is fail-closed behind the required --authorize-execution flag and remains unexecuted pending user authorization.

next_action: Review this design and authorize only the bounded 24-trace replay if desired. No training, policy rollout, task-count expansion, or Fold02 unlock is authorized by this design.
